text:
anya: Nightly eval flagged a regression for zh-HK translations — BLEU down ~6pts, weird punctuation/spacing in outputs. see eval-bot summary below.

eval-bot: nightly-evals for rwd-3b-quant-int8-v2 finished
```
model: rwd-3b-quant-int8-v2
benchmark: multilingual-translation-2026-03
metric BLEU: baseline=32.1 -> new=25.9 (-6.2)
chrF: 0.56 -> 0.49
samples_failed: 18/200
```

chao: can you paste a few failing examples? src/gt/pred

anya: sure, one sample:
```
SRC: 香港的天氣今天好熱。
GT: 香港的天氣今天很熱。
PRED (new): 香港 的 天氣 今 日 好 熱 。
PRED (baseline): 香港的天氣今天很熱。
```

ben: that spacing looks like tokenizer detokenization issue — spaces inserted between CJK chars. are we accidentally running a word-based detok for zh-hk variant? :thinking:

devon: fyi we pushed int8 quantization for rwd-3b into canary last night (~02:10 UTC). could be quant mismatch + tokenization chain.

chao: can we run the same sample through `tokenize --model rwd-3b-quant-int8-v2` and `--float32` to compare tokens?

anya: on it. also noticed `zh-hk` locale fallback to `zh` in the model locale map — maybe we picked a different tokenizer mapping.

ben: check config /models/rwd-3b/locale-map.json — last change was 2026-03-14

anya: quick tokenization diff:
```
float32 tokens: ["香港","的","天氣","今天","好","熱","。"]
int8 tokens: ["香","港","的","天","氣","今","日","好","熱","。"]
```

devon: yikes — int8 runtime seems to be using char-level fallback. that would explain BLEU drop.

chao: is this likely from the quantized tokenizer weights or from a runtime codepath selecting a different tokenizer? which component owns tokenization mapping at runtime — serving or model bundle?

ben: tokenization mapping lives in the model bundle metadata; serving runtime loads the tokenizer from bundle. model-ops: did the bundle change for the quantized variant?

anya: bundle version is rwd-3b-v2-quant-int8-20260319. comparing to v2-20260201 (float) now.

anya: diff shows `tokenizer.vocab` replaced with `tokenizer_vocab_char.json` in the quant bundle — probably an export bug.

devon: can we patch the quant bundle with the correct vocab? if yes, roll to canary and run nightly subset.

chao: also add a regression test for zh-hk/breaking tokenization in the eval suite — mark as blocker for quant rollout.

anya: will open an internal ticket and link it here. quick patch attempt and subset run ETA 30m.

eval-bot: job 9832745: subset-eval on hk-zh-samples queued by anya

anya: queued. adding sample failures to ticket. @devon please hold broader canary rollout until we validate.

devon: holding. thanks — please ping when fixed. :thumbsup:

ben: logging note — we should also surface tokenization diffs in nightly-eval report automatically.

anya: agree. filing follow-up.

chao: thanks all, ping me with artifacts and I'll help bisect further.

anya: will do — attaching initial ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4312

devon: added incident flag in case customers see regressions.

anya: closing loop here after subset results; keeping thread for updates.
